summary: The code effectively manages game initialization, enemy spawning, combat mechanics, and visual controls. It integrates animations and combat logic into the RuntimeBootstrap class, ensuring proper game state management. The structure is clear and functional, with all necessary components implemented.
evidence: RuntimeBootstrap class handles game initialization and core state management.
AutoStart method initializes the game and sets up visual elements.
DrawPlayerStatus and DrawRegionControls manage player and region controls.
AttackEnemy and RewardEnemyDefeat handle combat and rewards.
All components are logically organized and implement core game functionality.
